note: 原创站内听力练习（非官方真题）。词汇库目前含2组共40词，按日期轮换；听力练习含7组按日期轮换。
vocabularyBatches: allocate ≈ 把位置“挪给”某项任务
The university allocated more funds to student support.
令人信服的；引人入胜的
compel 是“迫使”； compelling 的理由让人不得不信
The report provides compelling evidence for the policy.
connect 一节一节连起来 → consecutive days 连续几天
She studied for five consecutive evenings.
de- 往下 + line 线 → 曲线下降；也可婉拒邀请
The number of applicants declined slightly.
emerge 想成从紧急出口 emerge 出来 → 出现
A clear pattern emerged from the survey.
想象数字像 flake 一样上下飘 → fluctuate
House prices fluctuate from year to year.
incentive 里有 cent（钱）→ 奖金是一种激励
Financial incentives can encourage people to recycle.
inter（之间）+ pret（说）→ 在信息之间解释含义
The results should be interpreted with caution.
just + ify → 让决定变得“公正合理”
The benefits do not justify the high cost.
maintain 像 maintenance 维修保养 → 让状态维持
It is difficult to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
notion 听起来像 note 的想法笔记 → 一个观念
The notion that success requires luck is widespread.
obtain 想成“把目标拿到手”
Students can obtain feedback from their tutors.
prior（在前）→ 排在前面的事情就是 priority
Improving public transport should be a priority.
re- 回到 + levant（抬起）→ 把相关信息提出来
Please include only relevant details in your answer.
sign（标记）+ ificant → 值得做标记的重要变化
There was a significant improvement in test scores.
把 trend 想成数据线持续朝一个方向走
The graph shows an upward trend in online sales.
valid 与 value 同源联想：有价值、站得住脚
The study raises a valid question.
wide（宽）+ spread（铺开）→ 广泛传播
The use of smartphones is widespread among teenagers.
种子 yield（产出）庄稼；谈判中 yield 是让步
The new method yielded better results.
approximate 像“靠近那个数”但不完全精确
The journey takes approximately two hours.
knowledge（知道）→ acknowledge 是承认知道某事
The author acknowledges the limits of the research.
Regular exercise is beneficial to mental health.
challenge 像把问题抛给你，需要回应
This evidence challenges the traditional view.
demo（演示）→ demonstrate 就是清楚展示
The experiment demonstrates how memory works.
effort 用得少、效果出来快 → efficient
Online forms make the process more efficient.
foundation（地基）联想 fundamental 基础的
Trust is fundamental to a good relationship.
hypo（下面）+ thesis（论点）→ 尚待验证的底层论点
impact 像撞击产生后果 → 影响
Tourism has a major impact on the local economy.
index（索引）指向信息 → indicate 表明
The findings indicate a need for further study.
major（主要的）→ 占主要部分的多数
The majority of participants preferred the first option.
never + the less 联想：即使如此仍继续
The task was difficult; nevertheless, she completed it.
out（出来）+ come（来到）→ 最后出来的结果
The outcome depends on several factors.
purchase 比 buy 正式，想成商店里的正式购物凭证
request（请求）联想 requirement 是必须满足的要求
The position requires strong communication skills.
strategy 是把战斗（战术）计划好
A clear strategy can improve time management.
The sample was small; therefore, the results are limited.
employ（雇用）加 un- 反义 → 没有工作
Youth unemployment remains a serious issue.
vary（变化）→ variety 是不同种类
The course offers a variety of learning activities.
where + as 联想两边并排比较，表示对比
City living is convenient, whereas rural life is quieter.

listening.title: 校园工作坊报名
listening.topic: 校园生活 · 时间定位
listening.script: The workshop starts at half past nine on Saturday. Please arrive ten minutes early to register.
listening.question: 工作坊几点开始？
listening.explanation: 听到 half past nine，表示九点半。
listening.tip: 留意 half past 表示几点半。

listening.title: 社区导览改期
listening.topic: 日常安排 · 日期定位
listening.script: The community tour was planned for Thursday, but it has moved to Saturday the eighteenth because of the weather.
listening.question: 社区导览改到了几号？
listening.explanation: 关键信息是 moved to Saturday the eighteenth。
listening.tip: 听到改期提示后，以 but 后面的新日期为准。

listening.title: 课程登记姓名
listening.topic: 报名信息 · 姓名拼写
listening.script: Could I have your surname, please? Patel. That's P-A-T-E-L.
listening.question: 姓氏如何拼写？
listening.tip: 姓名拼写要逐个记字母，注意相似发音。

listening.title: 健身中心会员费
listening.topic: 数字与费用 · 价格定位
listening.script: A monthly membership is twenty-four pounds. If you pay for the whole year, it is sixty pounds.
listening.question: 月卡费用是多少？
listening.explanation: 月卡是 twenty-four pounds；sixty pounds 是年卡价格。
listening.tip: 注意区分月费和年费，别被后续数字干扰。

listening.title: 图书馆自习室
listening.topic: 校园设施 · 地点定位
listening.script: The quiet study room is on the second floor, in room two hundred and four, opposite the computer area.
listening.question: 自习室的房间号是多少？
listening.explanation: 房间号为 two hundred and four，也就是 204。
listening.tip: 把数字按百位、十位和个位拆开记录。

listening.title: 志愿者培训时长
listening.topic: 活动安排 · 时长定位
listening.script: The first-aid training usually takes an hour, but today's session will be shorter and last forty-five minutes.
listening.question: 今天的培训持续多久？
listening.explanation: but 后面修正了常规时长，今天是 forty-five minutes。
listening.tip: 听到 but、however 等转折词时，留意后面的更正信息。

listening.title: 艺术展开放时间
listening.topic: 场馆信息 · 时间定位
listening.script: The gallery opens at a quarter past eight from Monday to Friday. At weekends, it opens half an hour later.
listening.question: 美术馆工作日几点开门？
listening.explanation: a quarter past eight 表示八点一刻，即 8:15。
listening.tip: 熟悉 a quarter past 表示过一刻。
